venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sat 9/12 (MOD JK).** Net $8,085 vs $8,495 target (95%); food $404; comps $90; 270 guests / $30 avg. Steady start; opener set the team up well and the first pop came ~9 once DJ Kiya started (always a crowd favorite). No barback — Keshawn stepped up and kept FOH stocked while balancing BOH. Highlight: neighbors/regulars Madison's bachelorette party celebrated in-house; regulars Ben and Zach also came in. Kitchen stayed on top of the rush with many compliments on the wings. Maintenance: lock on the bathroom nearest the liquor closet needs replacing. No 86s, no incidents, no-shows not charged. Entered by Daniel.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sat 9/12 (MOD KE / MD / DJ).** Net $9,881 vs $12,697 target (78%); food $371; comps $136 (1.37%); 316 guests / $31 avg. A slower Saturday — no early pop after open; industry friends around town report it's just a typical September so far. Intermittent waves from ~9pm; a 15-top birthday (Sophie Boilor) drank mostly house cocktails and ordered a handful of food items, especially the JoJos. A handful of guests stayed to 2am and past — good late-night-spot signal. Kitchen: smooth sailing. 86'd: Guinness on draft. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: regular Tiffany and her husband gushing over Joe's nephew's baby pictures. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sat 9/12 (AM Evan; PM Carey).** Total net incl. events $21,996.65 vs $18,636 target (118%); DC/AM $1,797.71, D&C PM $12,677.10, non-event net $14,503.65; net event sales $7,493 (event food $5,733); total food incl. events $8,729; comps $537.04 (3.71%); 358 guests (Tock) / ~$61.44 avg. AM: steady day that opened with a huge IRD the team had been briefed on and knocked out, ending with a nice cocktail pop; cold brew ready for 10am tomorrow. PM: start of football season hit — very slow for a Saturday, but great community members came through and the room stayed high-energy and full of laughter. Event: small wedding ceremony/reception for Jesse & Mercedes, 40 guests, 6–9pm in Vauxhall; Lucas W & Rachael produced apps and a spread; bride & groom thanked the team on the way out. Kitchen: chill night with Ayu and Fiellah (Fiellah went home early, unwell). Break make-up complete; no-shows charged; no incidents. Maintenance: cleaners due in the morning to disinfect the curtains by table 22. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sat 9/12 (MOD Kyler + Steves).** Total EOD net $7,146 vs $8,080 target (88%); food $672, beverage $6,475, retail $0; no events; comps $180.22 (2.52%); 208 guests (SevenRooms) / $34 avg. Slow start, picked up ~8 and kept going; Ella ran the door and floor comms and kept the room efficiently packed to last call. Waitlist skewed to 3s and 4s rather than 2s — refreshing but harder to fit around resos; no no-shows. Thomas's table of the night: a bachelor party in sailor hats (7–8pm) who were sent on to Dutch Kills afterward. Back catalogue of the day: Scorpion Sting, Lightning Rod, Technicolor, Pink Lady. Top sellers: Rosalie, Cloudwalk, High Plains, Native Lion, Burner Phone. Founding member Mathew Pokoik celebrated a birthday; member Brendan Eshaghy and investor David Kim visited. Menus 18/17. Breakage: 1 coupe, 1 collins (chip), 1 egg coupe (chip). Maintenance: leak above the downstairs bathroom. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by MK.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sat 9/12 (MOD Gianna, Joe, Julian).** Net $12,678 vs $12,777 target (99%); food $2,107; Standing Room $2,727 (food $264), Marquee $9,719 (food $1,803); no events; comps $158.66; 162 guests / $84.70 check avg as reported. Small rush right at open that kept the team busy through the after-dinner hours; fully staffed and focused. Large parties kept tables 1–3 busy all night; Standing Room was full at one point and the Marquee turned continuously. Cocktail and food pace were on a good margin; host did a great job moving traffic; a few stragglers at the end. Kitchen: 3-man team killed it, prepped during service, new cook up to speed immediately. Nothing on maintenance; no 86s; no incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: everyone hustling and helping each other on a busy shift. (Form date typed 2028-09-13; matched by post time to Sat 9/12.) Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sat 9/12 (MOD Josh).** Total net incl. events $12,952.59 vs $9,509 target (136%); Marquee bar $8,770.75; Garden closed for a private event; event sales $4,470.24; food $1,112; comps $288.40 (voids $2,041 'event void'); 237 guests / $39.82 avg (check avg $82.70). Hot day with a quiet start across the neighborhood; picked up later with a healthy mix of larger-party resos and walk-in groups. With the Garden closed, ticket and table times were the focus — got hairy when bar top and floor were completely full ~10:15pm; a waitlist was started and worked through quickly. Two team members stepped into new floor and barback roles — a few hiccups, all resolved in real time. Slowed ~1am; normal last call. Kitchen: steady; Rassan and James executed the event food while keeping regular service timely; 86'd popcorn and cookies caused EON confusion — late-night snacks must stay stocked. Went well: comms, host pacing. Improve: floor ticket pacing, late-night snacks, garnishing. Kitchen close checked. Maintenance: mid tap still leaks slightly after tightening; curtains. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: repeat guests who frequent the LA location. (Form date typed 9/13; matched by post time to Sat 9/12.)

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sat 9/12 (AM Sam & Lex / Shannon; PM Justin, James & Shannon, Marcus, Drew).** Total net $14,880 vs $14,266 target (104%); Municipal Bar AM $2,861 (88 guests), PM $9,252 (266 guests), Sun Club $633, Hot Eye $2,062; food $7,020; no events; comps $312; 354 guests / ~$42.03 avg. AM: quick start with 3 tables at 8am, dead 9–10, then a lunch push — busiest hour 12–1 nearly broke $1k; mellow into happy hour then a good late-afternoon push. PM: happy hour popping 4–5, brief lull, back up at 6:30; a few 7pm cancellations, then jumping by 8:30 with reso groups waiting in lounges/bar for flips; 10–11 quieter than the rest of the week; Maddie cut early and the team closed short-handed without issue. Sun Club: fun, chill, heavy-drinking crowd, mostly hotel guests with more locals daily; slow start, picked up 5–7 (Jack fell down the stairs and earned sympathy tips). Hot Eye: near-full at open, died after 8, pop at 10, then filled again ~11:30 with industry from the Grey, Common and others; decent sales despite a slow feel. Kitchen: slow start, picked up late, did well; dumplings low but not 86'd. Favorite moment: a hotel couple drank in THE, had a spa night, and came back for more. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sat 9/12 (MOD Curtis Hayes, Julian Abel).** Net $14,590 vs $10,000 target (146%); food $1,582; comps $381 total incl. ~$100 shift drinks; 308 guests / $46.07 avg as reported. Another big Saturday. Julian spent the first half downstairs keeping prep rolling as AT phased out — useful perspective on daily product throughput; Curtis and team held the floor upstairs with prowess. Steady cruising most of the shift; Tessa phased early for a deserved weekend; Josh demonstrated what the snacks should look like for tomorrow's service. Everything felt very dialed. Kitchen: good job Josh. 86'd: Dry Martini. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Alicia came to visit. (Note: guest count / check avg field is identical to Friday's entry — recorded as reported.) Entered by Julian Abel.
